description: March birthdays: zodiac signs and decans for every day of March, cusp dates, the month's numerology and its Chinese zodiac boundary.
answer: In Western astrology, March birthdays fall under Pisces and Aries. In most years March birthdays from the 1st to the 20th are Pisces, and from the 21st they are Aries. March 19, March 20, March 21 and March 22 are cusp dates. In numerology March is month 3.

sections.heading: Zodiac signs and decans in March
paragraphs: March starts in the second decan of Pisces, coloured by the Moon, so its earliest birthdays carry tenderness and a strong pull towards home. Around March 11 the third decan begins, and Pluto deepens the sign's sensitivity into something more intense and private. Around March 20 or 21, at the equinox, the Sun leaves Pisces for Aries, and the zodiac begins again. Few transitions in the year are as stark: mutable water gives way to cardinal fire, receptivity to initiative, endings to beginnings. Aries' first decan, with Mars doubled, carries the sign's most direct energy, and on March 31 the second decan begins with the Sun as sub-ruler. People born in March often describe living with both moods: the dreamer and the starter, the listener and the one who acts.

In most years March birthdays from the 1st to the 20th are Pisces, and from the 21st they are Aries. The cusp dates, where the sign can differ by year or time zone, are March 19, 20, 21 and 22; each has its own page explaining both possibilities. Decan by decan, the month opens in the second decan of Pisces, linked with Moon, from the 11th the third decan of Pisces, linked with Pluto, from the 21st the first decan of Aries, linked with Mars and from the 31st the second decan of Aries, linked with Sun.

sections.heading: March birthdays in numerology and the Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: March is month 3 in numerology, the number of creative expression, communication and optimism. It tends to add a social, playful note to the birth date and is often read as encouraging people to say what they think and make things others can enjoy. On the Chinese side, March birthdays follow the calendar year's animal, since Lunar New Year has always passed by then. The month pillar of Four Pillars astrology adds texture: the Rabbit month begins around March 5 or 6 with the solar term known as the Awakening of Insects, so nearly all March birthdays carry the Rabbit there. The Rabbit is traditionally linked with tact, refinement and a preference for calm progress, which sits interestingly beside the impatient fire of the Aries birthdays later in the month.
Every page for a March date lists the Life Path for several birth years, because the year changes the total even when the day stays the same.

sections.heading: Famous March birthdays
paragraphs: Each March page lists the best-known people born on that date, drawn from Wikidata and ranked by how many Wikipedia language editions have an article about them. A sample across the month: Yizhak Rabin (March 1), Miriam Makeba (March 4), Alessandro Manzoni (March 7), Osama bin Laden (March 10), Giorgos Seferis (March 13), James Madison (March 16), Valery Leontiev (March 19), Robert Andrews Millikan (March 22), Elton John (March 25), Maxim Gorky (March 28) and Al Gore (March 31). Sharing a birthday with someone well known says nothing about a life's direction, but it is a pleasant way into the date's sign, decan and numbers, which each page then explains in turn. The lists favour people with a precisely recorded birth date in the modern Gregorian calendar, so some much-celebrated figures from earlier centuries are missing.

faq.question: What is the numerology number of March?
faq.answer: March is month 3. The month is one of three parts of the Life Path calculation, with the day and the year.

faq.question: Which Chinese zodiac animal is someone born in March?
faq.answer: Lunar New Year has always passed by March, so a March birth takes the animal of the calendar birth year.
